Definition: foolishness, i.e. (morally) wickedness; concretely, a crime; by extension, punishment
BiblicalUsage: 1) senselessness, folly; 1a) disgraceful folly; 1a1) of immorality, profane actions; 1b) disgrace, contumely disgrace
